# Lato (Bold 700 and Black 900, the Latin subset)

The type of Form TV-1's Panel look (the cards of the training video). Lato is by Łukasz Dziedzic, licensed under the SIL Open
Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE`). The two files are the Latin subsets as published by Fontsource (`@fontsource/lato` 5.3.0,
`files/lato-latin-700-normal.woff2` and `files/lato-latin-900-normal.woff2`), unchanged. `tools/forms/TV-1/build.sh` puts them
into the form as `@font-face` rules (data URLs), so the cards draw in Lato with no network.
